name: YMCA Camp MacColl
description_short: A YMCA of Pawtucket day camp in Lincoln, RI for ages 5-15. Traditional camp groups campers by age (5-13) for archery, art, swimming, nature and sports; specialty and themed immersive weeks, a Leaders in Training program (13-15) and Voyagers travel camp (12-15) are also offered. Before and after care available.
activities: Specialty camps (art, basketball, culinary, nature, ninja, pickleball, soccer, sports medley)
Immersive theme camps (Disney, Harry Potter, Pirates, Super Mario, Star Wars, Survivor)

sources.note: Re-checked 2026-11-12: 'Register for Summer 2026!'; activities archery, art, swimming, nature, sports; traditional, specialty, immersive camps; maccoll@ymcapawt.org.

Day Camp page: Traditional Camp $275/week early bird through 1/31/26, $285 regular; Specialty $285/$295; Immersive $295; Before Care 7-8 am and After Care 5-6 pm +$25/week; '$25 non-refundable registration fee'; Weeks 1-9 June 22 - Aug 21 (no camp July 3 or Aug 10); groups Pathfinders 5-6 to Pioneers 11-13, LIT 13-15, Voyagers 12-15. Sessions use the $285 regular traditional rate.
